item.subject: science
item.stem:
Falguni lists benefits people receive from ecosystems such as forests and protected areas: fresh air, fertile soil, and conserved wildlife habitats. Ecosystem components depend on each other and support life while providing those benefits. She also notes mangrove forests and rivers, such as the Sundarbans, with varied flora and fauna.

Which claim best explains how ecosystems benefit humans?

options.A: Ecosystem components depend on each other and support life while providing benefits such as fresh air, fertile soil, and conserved wildlife habitats.
options.B: Humans benefit only from wildlife habitats, not from fresh air or fertile soil from forests.
options.C: Forests provide fresh air and fertile soil only when no flora or fauna live there.
options.D: Protected areas block all benefits because people cannot use wildlife habitats.
